description: This file contains functions for manipulating and optimizing torch.fx GraphModules, including removing extraneous pytree calls, swapping modules, and adjusting input/output signatures for exported models.

methods.name: _get_getitem_users
methods.description: Identifies nodes that use operator.getitem as a user of a given node.

methods.name: _try_remove_connecting_pytrees
methods.description: Attempts to remove unnecessary flatten/unflatten pytree calls between modules in a GraphModule.

methods.name: _remove_extraneous_pytrees
methods.description: Removes extraneous pytree flatten/unflatten calls from a GraphModule.

methods.name: _construct_inputs
methods.description: Constructs input nodes for a GraphModule based on a ModuleCallSignature.

methods.name: _insert_call_module
methods.description: Inserts a call_module node into the graph, assigning the module to the graph.

methods.name: _deconstruct_outputs
methods.description: Deconstructs the outputs of a module into a flattened form within the graph.

methods.name: _swap_module_helper
methods.description: Performs the core logic of swapping modules within a GraphModule, including partitioning, fusing, and replacing subgraphs.

methods.name: _fix_input_output_signature
methods.description: Adjusts the input/output signature of a GraphModule to remove pytree processing, embedding it into the graph.

methods.name: _swap_modules
methods.description: Main function to unlift an ExportedProgram and swap specified modules with eager modules, returning a modified GraphModule.
